system.description:
Skill: Deception

Exploit Type: Combat Exploit

You attempt to divert the attention of a target you can see within 30 feet. When you deal Lethal Attack damage, you may choose to forgo 2 Lethal Attack dice. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target cannot target you until the end of their next turn. A creature can only be affected by this Exploit once every 10 minutes.

activities.label: Lethal Attack (forgo 2)
activities.text: Once per turn, on a hit with advantage or with an ally within 5 feet of the target.

activities.label: Lethal Attack (forgo 2): Attack action or weapon
activities.text: An attack of the Attack action or a weapon attack: half the dice, rounded up (minimum 1).

activities.label: Feint
activities.text: A target within 30 feet. Failure: it can't target you until the end of its next turn. Once per creature every 10 minutes.
